title: 04. The Strong Digging Friend
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Rumble, rumble! At the building site, a big yellow machine digs into the ground with a long arm. Thump! Hori's eyes grow wide. Wow! What's that strong yellow friend? Rumble, thump! It's a digging excavator!
Dad, how can it dig without hands? Hori asks, holding the fence. Beside him, Bori stands on tiptoe to see. Dad smiles. Shall we take a closer look? But we must wear hard hats!

With yellow hard hats firmly on, they walk into the building site. Hello! Have you come to learn about excavators? A driver in blue work clothes and a yellow vest waves. Up close, the excavator looks as big as a house! Hori's heart goes thump, thump.

Oh! It doesn't have wheels! Bori tilts their head. Instead of wheels, it has continuous tracks, joined like a moving belt. They help it travel over bumpy soil and mud without slipping. With a rattle, the tracks turn slowly.

The excavator's long arm folds and stretches like our elbow. Oil pushed through the hydraulic system moves this arm. That gives it the strength to lift heavy soil. As the arm moves with a whir, Hori stretches his own arm, too.

At the end of the arm is a big scoop. This is the bucket. It scoops soil like a big shovel. Pointed teeth line its edge. These teeth scrape hard ground so the bucket can dig out soil. Bori counts the teeth. One, two, three.

Rumble! When the driver sits in the cab, the upper part turns around. The bucket scoops up soil, swings sideways, and pours it into the dump truck beside it. Wow! It turns to move the soil! Hori claps.

Want to try, Hori? Hori sits in the cab and gently pushes the lever together with the driver. Rumble, thump! The bucket lifts a scoop of soil! His tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. I dug the ground! Rumble, thump! It's a digging excavator!
Now it's time for real work. Rumble, thump! The excavator digs deeper and deeper. The bucket scoops the soil into the dump truck. Hori and Bori watch from outside the safety line. It's so strong!

On the way home, Hori holds Dad's hand and chats. Tracks carry it over the soil, the long arm moves the bucket, and the bucket's teeth dig the ground! The excavator does hard digging work for us. Hori smiles at the sky. Rumble, thump! It's a digging excavator!
